contentPattern: 1 row per tile, 1 cell: h3 containing the link (the link makes the whole tile clickable) + optional paragraph. If the h3 is not linked, the tile's first link (e.g. a link paragraph) is moved into the heading. Option 'blue': title only - a single linked paragraph or h3 per row. Section intro (eyebrow, h2, text) is default content above the block.
